body:
support-lead: planning a short overnight maintenance window for multiregion kernel updates + dedicated pool rotation. need statuspage snippet, customer email, and oncall rotation confirmation. target window: Apr 22 02:00-04:00 UTC. please review.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: window=2026-04-22T02:00:00Z..2026-04-22T04:00:00Z, regions=[us-east-1, eu-west-1], affected=Dedicated pools + runtime kernel patch. (id: maint-20260422-01)

alex: noted. we'll pin the runtime image for dedicated customers first, then rotate. plan: pin -> smoke -> staggered kernel rollout across gpods -> validate KV cache integrity -> unpin. rollback criteria: any >3% 5xx increase or error spike >30m. keep fallback models in same region.

emily: draft statuspage snippet below — keep short. please call out limited impact and expected degraded throughput for dedicated customers.

emily: ```Status: Maintenance in progress
Start: 2026-04-22 02:00 UTC
Duration: ~2 hours
Components affected: Dedicated GPU pools (us-east-1, eu-west-1)
Impact: Possible increased latency or request throttling for dedicated customers; hosted API unaffected.```

jamie: suggested customer-facing subject lines:
- "Planned maintenance: Dedicated GPU pools (Apr 22)" )
- "Short maintenance window — potential dedicated throughput impact"

emily: customer email draft below. please keep tone calm, list mitigation and contact channel.

emily: ```Hi there,

We're performing a planned maintenance on Apr 22, 02:00–04:00 UTC to apply kernel patches and rotate dedicated GPU capacity in select regions (us-east-1, eu-west-1).

What to expect:
- Possible brief periods of increased latency or throttling for Dedicated customers in the affected regions.
- Hosted API and embeddings unaffected.

Mitigation:
- Requests will automatically fall back to compatible model variants if needed.
- We'll pin versions during the rollout to limit surface area.

If you expect high traffic during this window, please schedule around it or contact support@redwood.com and we'll coordinate.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Status Team
```

sasha: legal/compliance note — add KMS audit mention for customers on Private: "No key material changes expected; audit logs will record rotation steps." Also preserve data retention notice in the email.

riley: oncall rotation: i'll staff primary (alex) and secondary (riley) for the window, with morgan as escalation. runbook pointer: https://internal/runbooks/dedicated-rotation; we'll post progress to status page every 15m.

morgan: can we add a short statuspage update template for periodic posts? e.g., "15:15 UTC — kernel rollout at 30% in us-east-1. No customer-facing errors observed." keep 1-2 lines per update.

emily: good call. status update template below:

emily: ```[HH:MM UTC] Maintenance progress: x% complete. Regions: [list]. Impact: [none/minor/moderate]. Notes: [smoke results / rollback triggers / next step].``` 

alex: ops checklist quick:
- create maintenance ticket in PagerDuty
- pin runtime image for dedicated customers
- create canary pool in us-east-1 (5% traffic)
- perform smoke tests (latency, kvcache integrity, 5xxs)
- rotate remaining pools in 20–30m intervals
- monitor SLOs and abort if rollback criteria met

support-lead: any objections to sending the email to customers now? we'll send to affected dedicated customers and post to statuspage 1 hour before.

emily: i can queue the email for 1h before window. final wording approved by jamie and sasha?

jamie: approved from comms side. keep subject variant 1.

sasha: approved from compliance.

morgan: ack. alex/riley you have ops priority. i'll be on-call for exec escalations. please update thread with any change to window. :thumbsup:

alex: ack. will start preflight at 2026-04-22T00:30Z and post preflight check results here.

riley: i'll publish statuspage 1h before and then 15m cadence during window. ping @support for customer messages.

support-lead: thanks team. putting together the final customer email + statuspage posts and scheduling now. will post the queued content here for a final read before send.

emily: queued content posted, ready for final review.

support-lead: sending approvals logged. closing coordination thread — will re-open if any unexpected changes. :white_check_mark:
